# The ball tray at the lane's foot: a mint trough 1.1 x 0.36 m, its floor 0.42 m up, a 6 cm rim. Up Z,
# front -Y; placed against the cabinet's front (world z 1.6..1.96).
new
material new Tray --base-color 0.0000 0.4706 0.6000 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 1.0000 0.1490 0.4549 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Floor --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.180 0.390
scale 1.100 0.360 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Tray
add mesh cube --name Front --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.340 0.450
scale 1.100 0.060 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name SideL --size 1 --location 0.530 -0.180 0.450
scale 0.060 0.360 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name SideR --size 1 --location -0.530 -0.180 0.450
scale 0.060 0.360 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name Leg --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.180 0.180
scale 0.900 0.300 0.360
apply --scale
material assign Tray
select all
shade flat
export tray.glb
